description:
Remove the old MainLayout tab bar, BacklogPage list view, ScenariosPage list view, ExecutionPage list view, and any dead routes/components after the graph workspace is live.

This cleanup should:
- remove PromptsPage as a top-level route (content moves to reference drawer)
- remove SettingsPage as a top-level route (content moves to settings modal)
- clean up unused stores, services, and types from the old tabbed model
- verify 301 redirects from old paths (`/backlog/:kind/:name`, `/scenarios/:name`, `/execution`) work correctly
- update agent-manager deep links to use new `/graph?...` URLs directly instead of relying on redirects
- delete stale dashboard-specific code paths, docs, and compatibility shims
- leave the codebase cleaner than before, with dead branches and stale abstractions removed

This item exists specifically to prevent the refactor from shipping with long-lived duplicate surfaces or legacy compatibility baggage.
name: swarm-manager-remove-legacy-tabbed-surfaces
title: Remove Legacy Tabbed Surfaces and Obsolete Dashboard Assumptions
